name: fig2_overview
caption:
Generate a publication-quality academic figure for a NeurIPS 2026 benchmark paper called 'FactoryBench'. White background, flat design, clean sans-serif typography (Inter or Helvetica Neue). The figure has a strict left-to-right horizontal layout with four main zones connected by thick dark navy arrows (#122128).

ZONE 1 — LEFT: Paper thumbnail (width ~15% of total). A realistic miniature academic paper preview with: Title in bold: 'FactoryBench', Subtitle: 'A Q&A Benchmark for Industrial Machine Understanding', Affiliation line: 'Technical University of Denmark', A small rendered image of a UR5e collaborative robot arm in grey, 3-4 lines of blurred dummy abstract text, A mini bar chart visible inside the thumbnail, Thin gray border, white background, subtle drop shadow, arXiv-style preprint header at top.

ZONE 2 — CENTER-TOP: Question box (full width of center). A prominent rounded rectangle with: Background: warm amber/yellow (#FFF3CD), Border: 2px solid #DC4B07 (Forgis flicker orange). Bold text: small gray label 'Question:', large bold black 'Has joint 3 friction increased between t=0ms and t=500ms?'. A thin orange left-border accent bar.

ZONE 2 — CENTER: Main data panel. Large rounded rectangle, light blue-gray background (#f0f4f8), dark navy border. Header label in dark navy bold: 'Sensor Data, Figures and Captions'. Contains THREE sub-elements arranged horizontally: [A: Time series plot] Matplotlib-style line chart titled 'Joint Current (t=0 to 500ms)', 6 colored lines for joints 0-5, with joint 3 (red, thick) showing a sharp upward spike at t=250ms annotated 'anomaly detected'. [B: Data table] Columns: Joint | Current (A) | Speed (rad/s) | Friction Δ% | Status. Joint 3 FAULT highlighted in red. [C: Bar chart] 'Model Accuracy by Level' with descending staircase pattern (L1=82%, L2=65%, L3=44%, L4=31%).

ZONE 3 — RIGHT CENTER: Input/Output funnel. Two vertically stacked boxes: Top 'Input Prompt' (orange), Bottom 'Model Response' (white).

ZONE 4 — FAR RIGHT: Three evaluation conditions. Three vertically stacked rounded rectangles: Box 1 (Blue) 'Sensor-Only', Box 2 (Orange) 'SCE-Schema', Box 3 (Green) 'Manual + Sensor'. Each with specific subtitle and answer tag.

BOTTOM CAPTION: Bold italic caption text: 'Figure 1: Illustration of the FactoryBench tasks. Given a question anchored in sensor data from industrial robots, we evaluate the capabilities of multimodal LLMs in comprehending and integrating information across multiple signals, tables and technical manuals.'

GLOBAL STYLE RULES: Navy #122128, Orange #FF762B, Blue #3a7bd5, Green #2ecc71, Red #FF4D00, Panel BG #f0f4f8. Thick 3px arrows, filled arrowheads. Rounded corners (8px). No gradients, no 3D effects. Aspect ratio 16:6 wide landscape. Print-quality.
context: FactoryBench: A Benchmark for Industrial Machine Understanding. This figure illustrates the diversity of tasks and the integration of multiple data sources (time-series sensors, tables, and manuals) used for model evaluation.
